title: Anti-Hallucination Specification Pattern - Universal Pattern for Preventing AI Interpretation Drift

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: A reusable pattern for creating hallucination-proof specifications that any AI agent can execute without guessing or fabricating details
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: NOT framework-specific. NOT a one-time solution. This is a UNIVERSAL pattern applicable to ANY specification work across ALL spokes.
_behavior_directive.processing_agent: Any AI agent writing specifications for cross-session or cross-agent execution
_behavior_directive.expected_outcome: All spokes adopt this pattern when creating implementation specifications, eliminating hallucination risk

pattern.name: Anti-Hallucination Specification Pattern
pattern.applicability: Any task requiring precise implementation by another agent/session

problem.description: AI agents hallucinate implementation details when specifications are vague
examples: Spec says 'store in appropriate location' → Agent guesses /tmp/ vs /var/ vs /opt/
Spec says 'handle errors gracefully' → Agent invents error handling logic
Spec says 'add relevant fields' → Agent fabricates field names not in requirements
Spec says 'reasonable defaults' → Agent makes assumptions about what's reasonable

solution.principle: Specify EVERYTHING explicitly. Cost of extra bytes < cost of misinterpretation.

1_exact_file_paths.description: Never say 'appropriate location' - specify exact paths
1_exact_file_paths.bad: Store the module in a suitable directory
1_exact_file_paths.validation: Path must be absolute, not relative. No placeholders like {project}

2_exact_function_signatures.description: Specify every parameter with type and default
2_exact_function_signatures.bad: Create a function to deliver lugs with necessary parameters
2_exact_function_signatures.good: def deliver_outbox_lugs(project_path: Path, interactive: bool = True) -> DeliveryReport:
2_exact_function_signatures.validation: Must specify: function name, all params, types, defaults, return type

3_exact_error_behaviors.description: Specify what happens for EACH error case

good.spoke_not_found_interactive: Call AskUserQuestion with valid spoke list from hub registry, user selects, update lug, retry
good.spoke_not_found_batch: Log warning, leave lug in outbox, continue with others
good.permission_denied: Log error, skip lug, continue with others
good.hub_path_missing: Log critical error, skip all hub deliveries

3_exact_error_behaviors.validation: Must have explicit behavior for: not found, permission denied, network error, invalid input

4_exact_field_lists.description: List ALL required fields, reject fabrications
4_exact_field_lists.validation: Specify: field names, types, required vs optional, valid values if enum

5_exact_step_order.good: Step 1: Distribute outbox (BEFORE state save), Step 2: Save state, Step 3: Cleanup
5_exact_step_order.validation: Use numbered steps. Specify dependencies. Mark if parallel execution allowed.

6_validation_questions.description: Include questions that MUST be answered exactly

example.question: What is the exact file path for the outbox delivery module?

7_forbidden_phrases.validation: Grep code for these phrases. Fail if found.

layer_1_spec_checksums.description: Hash specification content to detect drift
layer_1_spec_checksums.implementation: Store sha256 hash of spec in lug. Recompute before implementation. Fail if mismatch.

test_types: File path existence at exact location
Error handling for each specified case

layer_4_cross_agent_validation.description: Give spec to 2+ agents, compare implementations
layer_4_cross_agent_validation.process: If implementations differ, spec was ambiguous. Refine spec until agents produce identical code.

when_to_use: Creating implementation plans for other agents
Documenting APIs that agents will implement

how_to_apply.step_3: Replace all vague phrases with exact specifications
how_to_apply.step_5: List forbidden phrases relevant to this spec

checklist: [ ] All file paths are absolute and exact
[ ] All function signatures include types and defaults
[ ] Every error case has explicit behavior
[ ] Steps are numbered if order matters

bad_spec.content: Create a module to handle file uploads. Store files in an appropriate directory with proper validation. Handle errors gracefully and add relevant metadata fields.

content.function: def handle_upload(file: UploadFile, user_id: int) -> UploadResult:

validation.virus_scan: Call antivirus_scan() and reject if returns True

error_handling.invalid_extension: Return UploadResult(success=False, error='Only PDF, PNG, JPG allowed')
error_handling.virus_detected: Return UploadResult(success=False, error='File failed security scan')
error_handling.disk_full: Log critical error, return UploadResult(success=False, error='Storage unavailable')

forbidden: Do not add any fields beyond the 7 required fields

validation_questions.q: What is the exact file path for the upload handler module?
What happens if a user uploads a .exe file?
validation_questions.a: Return UploadResult(success=False, error='Only PDF, PNG, JPG allowed')
id, user_id, filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256_hash, uploaded_at

immediate: Add anti-hallucination checklist to specification templates
Update any in-progress specs to remove forbidden phrases
ongoing: Review all new specifications against checklist
Run validation questions on receiving agent
